ir.name: pairwise_advantage_gap_scaled_normalized_loss
ir.intuition: Fixed the failure due to excessive similarity by introducing normalization of the advantage_gap to prevent scale issues and adding clamping to stabilize the input to logsigmoid. This adjustment incorporates a scaling hyperparameter and normalizes advantage_gap norm to avoid numerical instability and improve discrimination, resulting in a distinct and robust loss that balances log probability differences with normalized advantage values.
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    scale = 10.0
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_adv = ops.max(ops.norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
    diff_log_prob = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
    scaled_diff = ops.clamp(ops.div(ops.mul(scale, diff_log_prob), norm_adv), -20.0, 20.0)
    loss_terms = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_terms, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
